title: Data Agents Need a Map: Evolving, Demand-Driven Knowledge of Large Collections
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Data agents now answer analytical questions over such collections with a full workflow per question, including dataset retrieval, join discovery and evaluation, and tailored program synthesis, most of which are discarded when a new task arrives.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A proof of concept on DAB, a benchmark for data agents, shows that with only part of the atlas a coding agent can already read a fifth to a third fewer tokens while achieving the same accuracy as without it.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Relationships between datasets and integrated views, which require comparing datasets, are instead built on demand for the areas of analysis that users declare.
